title: On the blank row SELECTEDVALUE returns BLANK as the one value, not the alternate result
query: EVALUATE ADDCOLUMNS ( VALUES ( Product[Color] ), "Product", CALCULATE ( SELECTEDVALUE ( Product[Product], "several" ) ) )

source.quote: An equivalent expression for SELECTEDVALUE(<columnName>, <alternateResult>) is IF(HASONEVALUE(<columnName>), VALUES(<columnName>), <alternateResult>) .
source.supports: SELECTEDVALUE returns the value when the column has one visible value, else the alternate

source.quote: VALUES includes the blank row caused by an invalid relationship, if present
source.supports: VALUES, and so HASONEVALUE, count the blank row

derivation: Sales rows 3 and 4 have ProductKey 9, missing from Product, so Product has a blank row and VALUES ( Product[Color] ) is Red, Blue and BLANK. Red has two products (Bike, Bell): the alternate. Blue has Lock. For the blank color the only visible row is the blank row, where Product[Product] has one value, BLANK: HASONEVALUE is TRUE and that BLANK is returned, not "several".
